moments.text: Infrared view of plain grey sky with a crosshair; black redaction boxes cover much of the screen. A small bright object, faint streak trailing right, holds above-right of centre.
The crosshair and magenta arc switch off for about five seconds; the object and its streak stay above-right of centre.
A blank grey frame, then a second clip with a red band across the top. The object, now smaller, drifts from left of the crosshair up toward the top.
The object leaves through the top edge; only empty sky around the crosshair for about 2.5 s.
The object drops back in from the upper left and hangs just above-left of the crosshair.
The crosshair switches off for about a second; the object moves up to the right and out through the top edge.
The crosshair returns. The object slips in and out along the top edge above the crosshair as the view shifts.
While the object sits just left of the crosshair, a second small bright spot appears at the right edge and moves up toward the top right. About 0.4 s.
The object drifts to the right of the crosshair, out to the right edge, then up and out through the top.
Empty grey sky around the crosshair to the end.

notes: Red bars left/right of the picture (and across the top in the second clip) are in the source, not cropped. Two clips joined at 29.27 s.
